```ts
export function getEffectiveAspectRatio(camera: Camera | null | undefined, targetWidth: number, targetHeight: number): number {
    if (!camera || !camera.viewport) {
        return targetWidth / targetHeight;
    }
    const viewport = camera.viewport;
    return (viewport.width * targetWidth) / (viewport.height * targetHeight);
}
```

In standard Babylon.js, `getEffectiveAspectRatio` is:

```ts
export function getEffectiveAspectRatio(camera: Camera | null | undefined, targetWidth: number, targetHeight: number): number {

        return targetWidth / targetHeight;
    }
    const viewport = camera.viewport;
    return (viewport.width * targetWidth) / (viewport.height * targetHeight);
}
```
